title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-zoe-kim-2026-03-21
content:
2026-03-20 / quick triage notes - Zoe

Context:
- Received customer email (Acme Corp) reporting intermittent dashboard timeouts and missing token-level cost breakdowns for a subset of requests (reported ~2026-03-19 21:10 PST).
- Slack thread: #console-triage - thread started by Priya.
- Possibly correlated with the release on 2026-03-19 (console v2.14.0) that touched metrics aggregation and the cost breakdown pipeline.

Observed symptoms (from customer and initial logs):
- Dashboard tiles fail to load (timeout) ~15-25% of requests for specific org org-acme-prod across eu-west-1 region.
- When tile times out, explorer traces show 504 from metrics-service gateway; metrics-service logs show a retry loop to cost-aggregator with increasing latencies.
- Some requests show missing token_cost field in response payloads (downstream UI hides breakdown -> blank state).

Quick repro steps tried locally:
1) Use staging snapshot of Acme's org config (limited access) -> could reproduce increased latency under small load using wrk w/ concurrency 8 hitting /dashboard/tiles for org-acme-test.
2) Captured logs from metrics-service: noticed repeated 429s from cost-aggregator when concurrent requests > 50.
3) Ran cost-aggregator smoke locally -> memory stable, but p95 latency spikes when redis cache miss rate > 40%.

Hypothesis / root-cause guesses:
- Recent changes to metrics aggregation increased on-the-fly aggregation work (more CPU) and bumped downstream cache miss ratio -> exposing capacity limits in cost-aggregator under certain org configs.
- Fallbacks in UI don't gracefully handle missing token_cost -> shows blank instead of error, making issue look like "missing data".
- Region-specific config (eu-west-1) might have slightly smaller burst capacity for the dedicated cluster running cost-aggregator for Acme (committed instances smaller).

Immediate next actions (TODOs):
- [ ] Pair with Priya to reproduce with load generator against staging and capture heap/CPU for cost-aggregator (owner: Zoe, due: 2026-03-21 11:00 PST).
- [ ] Check autoscaling metrics for cost-aggregator in eu-west-1 for org-acme-prod during incidents (owner: Samir).
- [ ] Add temporary retry/backoff + circuit-breaker logs to cost-aggregator to better surface 429s (owner: eng-runtime team: actionable via GH PR).
- [ ] Quick UI patch: show explicit "cost breakdown unavailable" message instead of blank for missing token_cost (owner: Jordan, low-risk patch).
- [ ] Contact Acme CS lead (Nora) with interim mitigation steps and ETA for fix (owner: Priya).

Notes for follow-up / longer term:
- Investigate cache key cardinality for cost-aggregator; add metrics for cache hit ratio per org and model variant. If certain orgs blow up cardinality, consider sharding strategy or TTL tuning.
- Consider precomputing cost-breakdown for heavy dashboards (batch job) for high-traffic orgs to avoid on-the-fly compute spikes.
- Add unit and integration tests covering scenario where token_cost field missing; ensure UI surfaces error and logs a Sentry event with org id + dashboard id.

Quick log excerpts (sanitized):
- metrics-service.log [2026-03-19T21:12:03Z] WARN requestId=abc123 upstream=cost-aggregator status=504 latency=12034ms
- cost-aggregator.log [2026-03-19T21:12:04Z] ERROR requestId=abc123 reason=rate_limited status=429 retries=3 org=org-acme-prod

Slack notes:
- Priya: "saw a spike in 429s around 21:05-21:25 UTC for eu-west cluster"
- Samir: "looks like cache miss rate jumped when we reprocessed metrics for model-x v1.2. Might be related to nightly batch overlapping with on-demand queries"

Priority and severity:
- Impact: medium-high (some customers see blank dashboards and timeouts intermittently)
- P0? Not currently P0 (no total outage), but customer is high-profile -> escalate if recurrence. Recommend P1 until fix deployed.

Proposed short-term mitigations (this week):
- Patch UI to surface missing breakdown (2-4h).
- Increase cost-aggregator replica count in eu-west-1 by +2 for next 48h to test if that reduces 429s (ops ticket).
- Add rate-limiter at metrics-service to shed non-critical heavy requests during spike windows (requires careful tuning).

Open questions:
- Did the release on 2026-03-19 include any config changes that could affect cache TTLs? (Release notes TODO: check).
- Is there any cross-org migration/job that ran during the incident window? (ask infra/release-engineering).

Action log:
- 2026-03-20 09:15 Zoe: created scratchpad, started local repro.
- 2026-03-20 10:00 Priya: confirmed customer contact, opened JIRA OBS-3241.
- 2026-03-20 11:30 Samir: pulled autoscaling metrics and flagged increased CPU p95 at 21:00 UTC.
- 2026-03-21 08:45 Zoe: attempted staging repro with wrk, attached trace ids to JIRA.

If anything else comes up I'll append here. Keeping this lightweight so it's easy to paste into the Jira ticket as a summary.

-- Zoe
